canonical_title: Normal acceleration at the pilot station

versions.title_at_revision: Normal acceleration at the pilot station
versions.text: Criterion: Verify that normal acceleration at the pilot station is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.2.1.6 Normal acceleration at the pilot station. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

versions.title_at_revision: Normal acceleration at the pilot station
versions.text:
Standard: The dynamic normal acceleration response at the pilot station to the pitch controller does not result in flying qualities worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the center of rotation in pitch is appropriately situated in relation to the pilot station as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Normal Acceleration at the Pilot Station paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the dynamic normal acceleration response at the pilot station as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Normal Acceleration at the Pilot Station paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the dynamic normal acceleration response at the pilot station as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Normal Acceleration at the Pilot Station paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
